notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are governmental funds here), no business-type funds, so business_type null. Receipts, disbursements, transfers and balances come from the Statement of Modified Cash Basis Assets and Fund Balances and Receipts, Disbursements and Changes (Exhibit III, pp8-15), Total Governmental Funds column (pp9, 11, 13). Printed transfers 265,054.09 = General 265,000 (to School Nutrition 150,000 and Activities 115,000) + Student Fee 54.09 to General; printed on pp9 and 13 outside receipts/disbursements totals. FIX PASS 3: the 300,000 Depreciation Fund 5200 Allocation from General Fund (p21) is now treated as a transfer everywhere. Non-Revenue Receipts (p9) reduced from 308,613.07 to 8,613.07 and the 300,000 added to transfers_in (565,054.09 = 265,054.09 + 300,000); General Fund Property spending (2650 100,000 + 2710 200,000, p36) split out of top-level lines 'Vehicle Operation, Maintenance, & Purchasing' (109,213.36 -> 9,213.36) and 'Vehicle Operation & Purchasing - Regular Education' (467,573.69 -> 267,573.69) and added to transfers_out (565,054.09). Printed totals (6,725,419.38 receipts; 6,495,626.91 disbursements) are unchanged and tie via includes_split of 300,000 each. Detail Sch M: contra expenditure lines (-100,000 and -200,000) plus other financing lines (-100,000 and -200,000) added, net zero against the printed total 5,959,371.64. Exhibit II (Statement of Activities, pp2-7) not used for amounts. Local Receipts 3,218,027.13 is split by category from the fund schedules (Sch A p17 without 1510 interest 58,042.37, which the statement shows as investment income; Sch I p26; Sch F p23; Sch G p25); the parts sum to the printed line. Detail: General Fund receipts from Sch A (pp17-18); General Fund spending from Sch M (operational expenses by program and object, pp28-38), which is more detailed than Sch B (pp19-20, program totals only), so Sch B and Sch A-1 (p16) were not recorded to avoid double counting. Sch M 8000 Transfers recorded as other financing (-150,000 and -115,000) inside the printed 5,959,371.64 total. Sch A 5200 transfer 54.09 and Sch C allocation 300,000, Sch F 115,000, Sch G 150,000 transfers recorded as other financing within printed receipt totals (includes other financing); Sch L (Student Fee) transfer -54.09 recorded as other financing, no totals printed. Sch D has no totals printed. Sch M zero-amount lines and blank-actual lines (budget only) were skipped; budget columns printed only on the last line of Sch F disbursements, Sch I disbursements and Sch C total are left null except Sch C 2900-700 (1,081,007 printed on that line). Object mapping used for Sch M: Other Property Services -> professional/contract services (except 2610 -> utilities, review), Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance, Other Items -> dues, training and travel. Identity check: 4,682,144.96 + 6,425,419.38 - 6,195,626.91 + 565,054.09 - 565,054.09 = 4,911,937.43 (equals the original 4,682,144.96 + 6,725,419.38 - 6,495,626.91 + 265,054.09 - 265,054.09). Read pages 1-38 of 38.
